about.title: About us
about.lead: Mawqaay is built by a small Gulf team for modest-fashion merchants.
body: We believe modest fashion deserves commerce software that speaks the culture: Arabic-first words, right-to-left layouts, and the rhythm of Ramadan and Eid built into a store's calendar.
Every feature — from the reservation timer to the payout ledger — exists because a merchant asked for it. Fewer options, more taste: what ships on the platform is what we would run on our own stores.

items.a: No — it is a modern, fast front-end with live cart logic, stock reservations and mobile-first RTL layouts.

Customers pay by bank transfer. Every receipt is checked against the exact amount and reference before the sale is final. The stock reservation timer pauses during review, so nothing expires out from under a paid order.
A small commission per completed order, set per store by the Platform Admin. There is no monthly fee while Mawqaay is in beta.

items.q: Can I bring my existing catalogue?
items.a: Yes — images, descriptions, sizes and colors work natively in Arabic or English, and shipping fees are set per governorate.
You do. Customer lists, orders and receipts belong to your store; the platform never sells or shares them.
